name: Astral Projection
overview: Scripture clearly forbids involvement with familiar spirits, wizards, and diviners, warning that seeking such practices defiles the believer and provokes God's judgment, as seen in Leviticus and Deuteronomy. While Ezekiel's experience of being carried by the Spirit of the LORD demonstrates divine spiritual transportation, it is distinct from human attempts at astral projection, which Scripture condemns. The imagery in Ecclesiastes about the silver cord and golden bowl underscores the fragility of life and the boundary God has set between the physical and spiritual realms. Ultimately, believers are called to worship God alone and avoid any occult practices that attempt to manipulate or traverse the spirit world apart from Him.
